interface_detail: Documented developer API (docs.fourthwall.com) with signed URLs; the `size` you declare is enforced at URL issue time.
chaining: 1 GB x 500 products on Pro = 500 GB ceiling — the only provider here where the account product count, not the file size, is the binding number.
